# Sales Trainer

## About Us
WOGOM is a B2B Commerce and Retail Enablement Platform, empowering 6,000+ retailers and 450+ sellers across India with better Products, Pricing, Credit, and Growth Opportunities. Our goal is to build a connected ecosystem where technology, capital, and commerce converge to help Indian retailers scale with confidence.

## Role Overview
The Sales Trainer will play a crucial role in developing and implementing comprehensive sales training programs for our sales teams, enabling them to effectively engage with retailers and drive business growth. This role will have a direct impact on WOGOM's mission by enhancing the sales team's performance and productivity. The ideal candidate will be a seasoned sales professional with a passion for training and development.

## Key Responsibilities
• Develop sales training programs for sales teams.
• Create interactive training content using gamification.
• Evaluate employee performance and provide feedback.
• Collaborate with departments for effective training.
• Train sales teams for pitch retention and growth.
• Develop training programs for business growth.

## Requirements
### Must-Have Skills
• Proven sales training experience and skills.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Gamification and sales expertise skills.
• Ability to evaluate and provide feedback.
• Strong sales principles understanding.

### Nice-to-Have Skills
• Experience with other training modules.
• Familiarity with training technologies.
• Knowledge of instructional design.

## Who Will Succeed in This Role
The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker, problem-solver, and creative individual who is passionate about sales training and development. They will have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and motivate sales teams. They will be a team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to achieving exceptional results, with a strong understanding of sales principles and practices.

# Sales Trainer

## About Us
WOGOM is a B2B Commerce and Retail Enablement Platform, empowering 6,000+ retailers and 450+ sellers across India with better Products, Pricing, Credit, and Growth Opportunities. Our goal is to build a connected ecosystem where technology, capital, and commerce converge to help Indian retailers scale with confidence. We are committed to providing innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers. Our platform is designed to facilitate seamless interactions between retailers and sellers, promoting mutual growth and success. By leveraging our expertise and resources, we aim to create a thriving ecosystem that benefits all stakeholders. We strive to maintain a culture of excellence, integrity, and customer-centricity in everything we do.

## Role Overview
The Sales Trainer will play a crucial role in developing and implementing comprehensive sales training programs for our sales teams, enabling them to effectively engage with retailers and drive business growth. This role will have a direct impact on WOGOM's mission by enhancing the sales team's performance and productivity. The ideal candidate will be a seasoned sales professional with a passion for training and development. They will have a deep understanding of sales principles and practices, as well as excellent communication and interpersonal skills. The Sales Trainer will be responsible for identifying training needs, designing engaging programs, and evaluating their effectiveness. They will also collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and maximize results.

## Key Responsibilities
• Develop and implement sales training programs that cater to the diverse needs of our sales teams. 
• Design and deliver engaging training sessions, workshops, and presentations that enhance sales skills and knowledge. 
• Conduct regular assessments to identify areas of improvement and provide constructive feedback to sales teams. 
• Collaborate with sales leaders to develop strategic plans that drive business growth and expansion. 
• Stay up-to-date with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies to continuously improve training programs. 
• Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs and make data-driven decisions to optimize results.

## Requirements
### Must-Have Skills
• Proven sales training experience with a proven track record of success. 
• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. 
• Strong understanding of sales principles, practices, and methodologies. 
• Ability to design and deliver engaging training programs that drive results. 
• Experience with sales performance metrics, analytics, and reporting. 
• Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making skills.

### Nice-to-Have Skills
• Experience with sales enablement platforms, CRM software, and other sales tools. 
• Knowledge of adult learning principles, instructional design, and training evaluation methods. 
• Familiarity with industry-specific trends, challenges, and opportunities. 
• Certification in sales training, coaching, or a related field. 
• Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with multiple stakeholders. 
• Ability to speak multiple languages or work in a multicultural setting.

## Who Will Succeed in This Role
The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker, problem-solver, and creative individual who is passionate about sales training and development. They will have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and motivate sales teams. They will be a team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to achieving exceptional results, with a strong understanding of sales principles and practices. The candidate will be adaptable, resilient, and able to navigate complex situations with ease. They will be a lifelong learner, always seeking opportunities to improve their skills and knowledge. They will embody WOGOM's values and culture, promoting a positive and inclusive work environment that fosters growth and success.
